verdict.rationale: Shopify ships its own UCP CLI with structured commands for catalog search, carts, checkouts and orders. The CLI reuses a one-time local profile and is configurable via environment variables like UCP_ON_ESCALATION, and a hands-on probe scripted it to create a real cart keylessly. MCP endpoints accept raw JSON-RPC calls, so non-interactive automation is evidenced. However, nothing documents CI or headless use as a supported mode, and completing a checkout requires a buyer handoff or Token-tier credentials, so end-to-end unattended runs are limited. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation (non-interactive flags, exit codes, machine-readable output guarantees, CI secret/token setup), and independent corroboration of the CLI running in a CI pipeline.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: the CLI provides structured commands to search the Catalog, build carts, create checkouts, hand off buyers, and track orders
Initialize it once and the CLI reuses it for every operation.
Set `UCP_ON_ESCALATION` before completing a checkout to open the merchant's `continue_url` in the buyer's browser automatically.
ucp cart create returned a live gid://shopify/Cart/ id
JWT tokens created from Dev Dashboard credentials have a 60-minute TTL
